$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for token prices. Loaded by framework/pricing.py (the
runner and the Python report engine) and by leaderboard-app/scripts/lib/pricing.mjs
(the Node build that produces the PUBLISHED reports). Before 2026-08-14 only the
Python table existed and the Node build had no cost logic at all, which is one of
the two reasons cost_usd_mean was null in every published report.
Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens. A run record stores TOKEN COUNTS, which are a
measured fact that stays true forever; the dollar figure is derived at report time
from this table, so historical results stay comparable when a provider changes its
prices. Never write a dollar figure into a run record.
Free-tier routes are listed at their PUBLISHED list price, not 0.00. 'Free for us
right now' is a property of our account, not of the model — a cost table printing
0.00 for every free route would claim the benchmark is free rather than that our
quota is.
Update checked_on whenever you touch a number, and re-check before publishing any
cost figure (see max_age_days).
SCOPE OF A RECORDED COST: usage is captured from the SUCCEEDING attempt only
(players/adapters/openai_compatible.py). Tokens burned by failed or timed-out
retries are not recorded, so on a retry-heavy run the published figure understates
what the provider billed. The recorded semantics are 'the cost of the answer we
published' — which is what keeps a cost-per-catch figure comparable across players
— not 'our total spend'. Do not cite these numbers as the latter.
